# Predictive Maintenance & OEE v1.0.0

<!-- Generated by `python -m writeup.report_phase9` from the results files; do not edit by hand. -->

First complete release: data pipeline, remaining-life forecasts with uncertainty, crew scheduling, a simulated plant, shift-by-shift monitoring, dashboards and the write-up, every number re-checked by independent code in CI.

## Headline results

- LSTM remaining-life error on unseen NASA engines (FD003): 12.66 cycles RMSE vs 15.50 for XGBoost.
- Simulated OEE, 200 machines: 98.2% predictive vs 97.8% fixed interval vs 95.2% run to failure; simulated unplanned failures 8 / 21 / 200.
- Misses, reported as measured: Phase 7's drift test raised false alarms on 11.6% of clean test runs against a 5% target (not met). Phase 7b's new rule failed its pre-registered criterion C1 on FD004: 19.5% and 13.9% of clean runs flagged (synchronized and staggered fleets) against a 5% limit. Both are reported, not re-tuned.
